quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White on the challenge of playing against Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: It's like a chess match. You throw a punch and he's so good that he's going to throw a counterpunch.
quotes.quote: I think it would be fun to play with Steve Nash. I'd love those Steve Nash teams. All I know is the best lob thrower, Andre Miller, and it's not even close. It's like a chess match. You throw a punch and he's so good that he's going to throw a counterpunch, and you can't really give guys like that the same look. He's been the best player in the NBA for a long time, however many MVPs, so it's definitely a chess match and it's something that evolves throughout the game.

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White on the special feeling of playing in Denver
quotes.excerpt: It's always special to come home and play in front of your family, all your friends.
quotes.quote: My entire time in the league, the Nuggets have always been really good, so it's always been a big game. There is that aspect of playing the Nuggets, playing with Nikola Jokic, so there is that aspect you would get with any good team, but it's always special to come home and play in front of your family, all your friends. All your friends, all your family comes there to support you and you kind of remember when you were a kid in the stands at the Pepsi Center, the Ball Arena. It was the Pepsi Center when we were kids, and so you kind of remember that, you kind of go back to being a kid again.

quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White on the development of the young Celtics team
quotes.excerpt: We got a really young team and we're trying to figure out who we're trying to be.
quotes.quote: Going to play a big East team, we got a really young team and we're trying to figure out who we're trying to be, just kind of define that culture, and so it was cool.
